page_title: PSG 3-1 MAR | PSG v Marseille 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The PSG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Here is a change. Geoffrey Kondogbia is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Darryl Bakola (Marseille).
89' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Vitinha (PSG) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
86' Kang-In Lee (PSG) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Geronimo Rulli gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
84' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Valentin Rongier is replaced by Neal Maupay (Marseille).
84' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.

83' Ambitious effort from Bradley Barcola (PSG). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
80' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Ousmane Dembele will be replaced by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Lucas Hernandez (PSG) coming on for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.

80' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball miles wide of the left post. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
80' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
79' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Marseille get a corner.
76' 3 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Pol Lirola (Marseille), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 3:1.
74' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
72' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Desire Doue and he is replaced by Joao Neves (PSG).
72' Flag up against Achraf Hakimi (PSG). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
68' The linesman signals that Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
67' That was close by Mason Greenwood (Marseille)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
66' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
66' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
65' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Clement Turpin blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' A substitution has been made. Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) goes off and Bradley Barcola comes on.
63' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pol Lirola (Marseille) replacing Luiz Felipe.
63' Amar Dedic goes off the pitch and Quentin Merlin (Marseille) comes on.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bilal Nadir (Marseille) leaves the pitch and Mason Greenwood comes on.
63' A quickly taken corner by PSG.
62' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Geronimo Rulli. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.

60' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from just outside the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball bounced away off the right post!
59' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
57' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Adrien Rabiot feeds Amine Gouiri (Marseille), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:1.
51' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
50' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
48' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
48' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
46' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Fabian Ruiz plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Nuno Mendes (PSG). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
40' Desire Doue (PSG) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
39' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Nuno Mendes (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' The corner from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is hurriedly cleared.

35' Amar Dedic (Marseille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Marseille will take a corner kick.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
34' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Marseille earn a corner.
33' A pass by Bilal Nadir (Marseille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
32' Half-chance! Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
30' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
30' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
29' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

28' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
27' It seems like Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
26' Nuno Mendes (PSG) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
25' None of the Marseille players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
23' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is adjudged offside.
22' The foul by Valentin Rongier (Marseille) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' 1 - 0 Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
17' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
16' Marseille have a free kick.
16' Willian Pacho (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
15' A precise first-time shot by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.
12' Nuno Mendes (PSG) commits a foul and Clement Turpin immediately signals a free kick.
12' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) takes the corner but it's cleared.

11' A neat pass is well received by Nuno Mendes (PSG), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
9' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
8' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' PSG take a short corner kick.

4' Nuno Mendes (PSG) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to PSG.
3' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
2' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Gianluigi Donnarumma.
2' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
1' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul. Marseille earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Clement Turpin.
